# The Journal of Pediatric Research

> An open-access, peer-reviewed pediatric research journal published by Ege University Faculty of Medicine with rigorous editorial standards and comprehensive author guidelines.

The Journal of Pediatric Research is the official publication of Ege University's Department of Pediatrics, published by Galenos Publishing House. The journal maintains high standards for research ethics, data reproducibility, and inclusive academic publishing while charging no author fees.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-review process
- research ethics
- pediatric research
- editorial standards

- [Abstracting and Indexing](https://jpedres.org/abstracting-and-indexing): Indexing services and abstracting databases where journal is listed

## Editorial Leadership

- [Editorial Board](https://jpedres.org/editorial-board): List of editorial board members overseeing The Journal of Pediatric Research
- [Scientific Advisory Board](https://jpedres.org/scientific-advisory-board): Scientific advisory board members providing guidance to the journal
- [Roles and Responsibilities](https://jpedres.org/roles-and-responsibilities): Guidelines on roles and responsibilities for editors, authors, and reviewers
- [Recruitment of Editors](https://jpedres.org/recruitment-of-editors): Information on editorial board recruitment and open editor positions

## Author Guidelines and Policies

- [Authorship and Contributorship](https://jpedres.org/authorship-and-contributorship): Authorship criteria and contributorship guidelines for manuscript submissions
- [Article Processing Charges (APC)](https://jpedres.org/article-processing-charges-apc): Article processing charges policy; journal charges no author fees
- [Copyright and Licensing](https://jpedres.org/copyright-and-licensing): Copyright and open-access licensing terms for published articles
- [Data Availability and Reproducibility](https://jpedres.org/data-availability-and-reproducibility): Data availability requirements and reproducibility standards for submissions
- [Artificial Intelligence (AI)](https://jpedres.org/artificial-intelligence-ai): Guidelines on artificial intelligence use in research and manuscript preparation

## Research Ethics and Integrity

- [Conflicts of Interest](https://jpedres.org/conflicts-of-interest): Conflict of interest disclosure requirements and policies

- [Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Accessibility (DEIA)](https://jpedres.org/diversity,-equity,-inclusion,-and-accessibility-deia): Diversity, equity, inclusion, and accessibility policies and commitments
